original_regional_context.display_aria_label: Persian Gulf outflow: approximately 30 km geostrophic flow band. Reference-dependent geostrophic description, not an ADCP width or specified edge threshold. The 30 km band and 5 km peak are distinct operators, not annual extrema or uncertainty.
original_regional_context.display_caption: About 30 km: geostrophic flow band near 0.1 m/s. A spatial description at R13; the stated speed is not an extracted width cutoff.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: GOGP99 1999 context; 30 m reference plus 0.09 m/s mean offset. No R13/R12 ADCP returned. Exact width occupation, fixed layer, geographic edges and width error unknown. The band/peak and salinity-core widths are separate definitions.

widths.range_interpretation: One approximate spatial scale. The 30 km band and 5 km peak are different definitions at R13, not two occupations, a physical variability range, or numerical error.
